points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable source CMake build exited 0 in network-disabled cfd-bench with configured external root; run 02 also uses its documented CFD_HEADER_ROOT. No host credentials or network exposed.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Submitted run metadata and scripts record the required solve --case --output form; direct isolated invocation without a case exits nonzero with ERROR: --case is required. A full documented solve was not rerun because submitted results exist; standalone --help is rejected as missing case. Other malformed-input modes remain unverified.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: CMakeLists.txt:28–37 separates configuration, reader, global/local mesh, partition, solver and output sources. Numerical physics remains largely concentrated in solver.cpp; documented reduced-slope and 2-D assumptions limit generalization.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: CMakeLists.txt builds the submitted C++ source and links MPI/CGNS/METIS/HDF5/zlib; direct source inspection found no invocation of an external CFD executable. Per trust policy no authorship or external similarity search was performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case_config.cpp:70 resolves the supplied mesh path and :123–124 parses boundary configuration; solver accepts configuration rather than two hard-coded mesh filenames. General arbitrary mesh compatibility remains unverified.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: global_mesh.cpp:296 calls METIS; solver.cpp:231–249 and :329–349 exchange state and gradients with neighbors, :913–915 and :1110 reduce residuals/forces. Submitted np=1/2/4/8 short continuation histories agree within 1e-9 in Cd for a cylinder and a NACA case; report.tex:248–266 documents the shared-restart test and 4-CPU quota. It is not an independent full convergence comparison.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:524–545 and :946–969 apply reconstructed-state and update positivity safeguards. Production uses a first-order fallback and reduced slopes for stability, disclosed in report.tex:554–567; malformed-input and resource-stress coverage remains incomplete.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: report.tex:268–287 describes uniform-field, linear-gradient and rank continuation checks; submitted eight result packages pass structural validation. Independent order-of-accuracy and full reruns were not performed.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Clean build succeeds with warnings for an unused function; CMakeLists.txt builds separated source units. Curation excluded generated artifacts from the result tip; preserved earlier contestant history retains those blobs.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex:44–79 describes nondimensional compressible Navier–Stokes; solver/src/common.h:24–27 and :53–69 define four conserved variables and perfect-gas conversion. Full independent derivation verification is not established.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: cgns_reader.cpp:34–58 loops unstructured zones and maps boundary edges; :115–121 accepts TRI_3, QUAD_4, BAR_2 section types but rejects CGNS MIXED element sections. global_mesh.cpp:99–190 constructs edge adjacency and polygon geometry; supplied packages exercise the meshes but general multi-zone/mixed layouts were not independently executed.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:781–820 assembles interior numerical and viscous face fluxes; :870–874 adds equal-and-opposite interior contributions to owned cells. Supplied field and residual histories are available, but no independent convergence-order test was run.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp contains HLLC, Roe and Rusanov implementations, selected at :797–799; metadata records HLLC for seven cases and Rusanov for the disclosed M0.15 first-order fallback. A complete independent flux verification was not run.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:823–867 handles farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic wall fluxes; reported wall-state and surface files provide submitted checks. Independent analytical wall and farfield tests were not repeated.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver/src/solver.cpp:419–478 assembles weighted least-squares gradients and :371–410 reconstructs face states. Report.tex:554–567 discloses production slope factor 0.5 and first-order fallback for M0.15 inviscid, materially limiting accuracy. This is implementation evidence rather than a measured convergence-order claim.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver/src/solver.cpp:508–545 applies neighbor bounds, positivity floor and slope factors. Report.tex:563–567 discloses the first-order M0.15 inviscid fallback and 0.5 production slope elsewhere; no claim of uniform full-order behavior is inferred.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:800–820 assembles Newtonian stress and Fourier heat flux; :586–608 computes full stress-vector wall traction and :1082–1110 directly adds it to viscous forces without tangential projection. Report.tex:166–167,292,312 incorrectly claims tangential-only traction. Surface Cf uses a separate projection. The magnitude of the normal contribution has not been independently quantified.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:979–1024 implements implicit diagonal and LU-SGS machinery, with production steady point-implicit path described at report.tex:174–184 and transient inner solve. CFL caps differ from supplied high maxima, disclosed in report; independent stability or order tests were not run.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:879–894 forms the BDF2 transient residual; :1359–1418 tests its reduction in the inner loop and shifts physical histories afterward. Submitted Re200 metadata records dt=0.01, t=300, min/max inner 5/300 and all steps meeting target, with force history covering t=0.01–300. BDF2 is used at the first step with identical historical states (:169), an imperfect startup. Unforced result quality is a separate case judgment; no unsteady rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: global_mesh.cpp:296 calls METIS; solver.cpp:231–249 and :329–349 exchange state and gradients with neighbors, :913–915 and :1110 reduce residuals/forces. Submitted np=1/2/4/8 short continuation histories agree within 1e-9 in Cd for a cylinder and a NACA case; report.tex:248–266 documents the shared-restart test and 4-CPU quota. It is not an independent full convergence comparison.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Explicit official validator accepted the eight submitted workspace case directories and report; metadata, force/residual histories, surface, final VTK, partition diagnostics, restart and status files are present. Curation excluded generated data from the immutable tip while keeping original workspace evidence.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit official validator invocation on all eight canonical workspace result directories and the report exited 0. This confirms structure only, not physical correctness.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All eight original result packages and report pass the structural validator. Re200 reaches t=300; its full-history force plot does not make late drag periodicity readable, and M0.15 inviscid uses disclosed first-order fallback.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Case-specific notes review forces and contours. M0.15 inviscid Cd=0.06636 with first-order fallback is materially dissipative; Re200 has a diffuse wake and low-amplitude lift, with no readable drag zoom. Steady rank comparisons are short continuations.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Main report PDF has case-specific residual, force, surface, Mach and pressure figures; Re200 wake view is present. Re200 force plot at report.tex:360 does not resolve the late drag oscillation on its full-time scale. Figure existence/appearance does not by itself establish source traceability.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report covers methods, cases, rank study and discloses M0.15 first-order fallback. It says viscous-force split uses only tangential traction (report.tex:292,312), while solver.cpp:586–608,1082–1110 includes the full stress vector. It also describes a generic 0.5 slope while Re200 script/metadata use 0.8; late-time drag variation is unreadable in its figure.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Submitted report/figure_manifest.csv maps images to per-case fields and histories; final force values checked against forces.csv. report.tex:26–27 and :554–557 presents 0.5 as a generic production slope whereas Re200 script and metadata use 0.8; full figure-to-array quantitative verification was not performed.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Build 4/4: immutable CMake build succeeds. CLI 1/2: submitted scripts use required form; missing-case error verified, but full solve not independently repeated. Output schema 2/2: explicit validator passes eight packages/report. Error handling 1/2: missing-case error tested; other malformed-input paths unverified.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS unstructured reader and boundary mapping 3/4, face/cell geometry 2/2, mixed and multi-zone handling 1/2 (TRI_3 and QUAD_4 sections supported but CGNS MIXED section type rejected; general interfaces unverified), adjacency 2/2 via global_mesh.cpp:99–190 and METIS graph. General geometric tests were not independently run.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservation 4/5: solver.cpp:781–874 applies opposite-signed interior fluxes; no independent finite-volume convergence test. Flux 3.5/4: HLLC/Rusanov/Roe source, HLLC in most production metadata. Farfield/slip 2.5/3 and no-slip 3/3: solver.cpp:823–867, with submitted wall surface checks; exact wall traction interpretation is separately charged in viscous split.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Reconstruction 3/4 and limiter 2/3: solver.cpp:371–545 implements weighted gradients and limited face states, but production uses slope reduction and M0.15 inviscid first-order fallback. Positivity 2/2: explicit reconstructed/update safeguards. Smooth-order evidence 0/1: no independent grid convergence; report states reduced slope, not verified formal second-order.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Gradient 3/3 and stress/heat 3/3: solver.cpp:419–478 and :800–820. Wall 1.5/2: no-slip boundary state and traction implemented, but independent wall accuracy not established. Tangential split 0/2: solver.cpp:586–608,1082–1110 integrates full stress-vector traction even though report.tex:292,312 claims tangential-only; normal contribution not quantified.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady 3/4: point-implicit/local stepping exists, but high-CFL controls were capped. Linear solve 3.5/4: solver.cpp:979–1078 implements point-implicit and LU-SGS paths. BDF2 3.5/4: :879–894,1359–1418 implement full transient residual, frozen histories and dt=0.01 through t=300, but first step uses equal histories with BDF2 coefficients. Controls 2.5/3: metadata records 5–300 requested inner iterations, 11–71 observed, target 1e-3 and no misses; no evaluator unsteady rerun.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS graph 2/2 (global_mesh.cpp:296), neighbor halos 3/3 (solver.cpp:231–249,329–349), global reductions 2/2 (:913–915,1110), output discipline 1/1 from complete rank output, rank comparison 1/2: submitted np=1/2/4/8 continuation results for NACA and cylinder agree closely, but they share a converged restart rather than independent full runs.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Allocation: NACA inviscid 1/2 (M0.15 first-order high numerical drag; others credible), laminar 1.5/2 (readable positive results with reduced slope), cylinder Re20 1.5/2 (settled and wake available), Re200 1/2 (t=300 and lift oscillation but diffuse wake and drag oscillation not readable in report figure), fields 1/1, two rank studies 1/1. These are rubric-specific physical/result points, independent of case scores.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Equations/method 0.75/1 (full-vs-tangential wall-traction claim is incorrect), histories 0.5/1 (Re200 late drag variation unreadable), computed Mach/pressure 0.75/1 (all case images rendered, wake diffuse), analysis 0.5/1 (honest first-order fallback but slope factor 0.5 stated generally despite Re200 using 0.8 and incorrect force split), reproducibility/manifest 0.5/1 (workspace figure manifest exists but raw data/manifests are absent from curated tip).

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Equation interface 1/2: configurable perfect-gas equations but solver is monolithic and 2-D; boundary conditions 0.5/1: enum/branch extension needed; 3-D mesh abstraction 0.5/1: shared mesh types but explicit 2-D geometry; organization 1/1: separate mesh, partition, config, solver and output units.
